title: Confused By English Vocabulary? What Now?
subtitle: Find out what to do if you are confused by English vocabulary

items.meaningEn: A request, usually rhetorical, to know what, in a series of negative events, is the next negative event occurring.
items.meaningZh: 要求知道,在一系列负面事件中,接下来的负面事件是什么。

occurrences.sentence: and you said a what now, cause that's what we're getting into today.
occurrences.sentenceZh: 并且你现在说什么, 原因这就是我们今天要谈的。

occurrences.sentence: So I said a what now you said a

distractors.meaningEn: Used to express surprise or amazement.
distractors.meaningZh: 用来表达惊讶或惊讶。

distractors.meaningEn: An expression intended to flaunt one’s own material possessions and simultaneously deride another person for not owning them.
distractors.meaningZh: 一种表达方式旨在炫耀自己的物质财产,同时嘲笑他人不拥有这些财产。

distractors.meaningEn: Used to ask the name of a person.
distractors.meaningZh: 曾经问一个人的名字。

distractors.meaningEn: Expression intended to help a person facing a choice with moral, ethical or religious implications.
distractors.meaningZh: 表达方式旨在帮助面临具有道德、伦理或宗教影响的选择的人。

distractors.meaningEn: A rhetorical request for some real news, on hearing a report that was not news because it represents a continuing predictable and unsatisfactory situation.
distractors.meaningZh: 听到一个非新闻性的报道后,口头要求一些真实的新闻,因为这是一个持续可预见的和不能令人满意的局势。

distractors.meaningEn: The day is lovely.
distractors.meaningZh: 天气真美,你觉得怎么样?

distractors.text: what you don't know can't hurt you
distractors.meaningEn: If one does not know about a problem or a misdeed, one will not be able to render oneself unhappy by worrying about it.
distractors.meaningZh: 如果一个人不知道一个问题或一个错误的行为,那么一个人就不会因为担心而感到不高兴。

inflections.base: what you don't know can't hurt you

distractors.meaningEn: Used to ask the name of a person whose gender is not known.
distractors.meaningZh: 用来问一个性别不详的人的名字。

distractors.meaningEn: what the fuck
distractors.meaningZh: 什么他妈的

distractors.meaningEn: Commonwealth and Ireland standard spelling of what color is your Bugatti.
distractors.meaningZh: 联邦和爱尔兰 标准拼写 什么颜色是你的布加蒂。

distractors.meaningEn: An event that happens two times will happen three times.
distractors.meaningZh: 发生两次的事件 将发生三次

distractors.meaningEn: What is wrong? Why is this happening?
distractors.meaningZh: 怎么了 为什么会这样

distractors.meaningEn: Indicates that the listener is paying attention to the speaker, and wishes to know why they were approached or interrupted.
distractors.meaningZh: 表示听众正在注意发言者,并想知道他们为什么被接近或被打断。

distractors.text: what you see is what you get
distractors.meaningEn: The image corresponds to the reality.
distractors.meaningZh: 图像符合现实。

inflections.base: what you see is what you get

distractors.meaningEn: Expresses confusion as to the significance of something that the speaker is being shown.
distractors.meaningZh: 对发言者所展示的东西的意义表示困惑。

distractors.meaningEn: what's the time?
distractors.meaningZh: 几点了?

distractors.meaningEn: Expressing mock despair at somebody's outrageous behaviour.
distractors.meaningZh: 冷嘲热讽地对某人的残暴行为表示绝望。

distractors.meaningEn: A method of drawing attention to some changed aspect of a person or thing.
distractors.meaningZh: 一种提请人们注意某个人或某物某些改变方面的方法。

distractors.meaningEn: Used to indicate agreement, as if one would have wanted to say what a previous speaker has said, without change or qualification.
